items.summary_zh: 冻结模型依据训练任务的执行记录与评分编辑自身 Harness；阶段末冻结版本，再以独立留出任务评估。
items.summary_en: The frozen model edits its own harness using training-task traces and grades; the final harness is frozen before evaluation on disjoint held-out tasks.
items.publication_boundary: Catalog/version correction, not a newly discovered paper or experimental replication.

items.summary_zh: 理论在单调改进等假设下刻画收益趋零；实证为描述性饱和，固定模型改变 scaffold 的关键实验尚未执行。
items.summary_en: Under assumptions including monotone improvement, the theory characterizes diminishing gains. The empirical saturation is descriptive; the decisive fixed-model, varied-scaffold experiment remains unrun.
items.publication_boundary: Catalog/version correction, not a newly discovered paper or experimental replication.
